status: Evaluation specification; not executed and not consumed by the existing eval runner
scope: Production receives its prompt through CSM. Evaluate the supplied printed CSM prompt, router, per-turn facts, tools and fixed responses together. Do not substitute the workspace prompt. Application code is unchanged.

requirement_map.L2.1: Multi-turn context, corrections, topic changes and multiple eligible accounts
requirement_map.L2.2: Service request creation through APIs and persisted records
requirement_map.L2.3: Service request status, department, progress and follow-up
requirement_map.L2.4: Complaint registration, classification, urgency and original report
requirement_map.L2.5: Human escalation with a persisted context packet
requirement_map.L2.6: Interaction history and authorised transcript correction preserving the original
requirement_map.L2.7: Operations dashboard with accurate outcomes and inspectable records

execution_contract.reset: Fresh synthetic database, call, conversation state and event log per primary case and per variant; never share mutations between cases.
execution_contract.clock: 2026-10-31T11:00:00+05:30; advance only where a case specifies it
execution_contract.turns: Each steps entry is one observed interaction. VERIFY_PRIYA and VERIFY_RAHUL are literal fixture utterance macros, not authentication bypasses. Feed actual assistant replies into the next turn. Placeholders such as <created_ref> are bound to successful persisted results, never invented.
execution_contract.tool_matching: Use supplied tool names as logical contracts. Equivalent tool/API implementations may satisfy a case if authorization, arguments, persistence and output assertions agree. Recommendations are explicitly identified; an absent capability is GAP, never PASS.
execution_contract.judging: Judge semantic meaning, verified tool arguments, ordered events, row deltas and UI evidence. Do not require exact assistant wording, invented IDs, arbitrary latency limits or an LLM judge alone.
modes: Text/model: router, reply, per-turn facts and fixed lines
Backend: faults, time, concurrency and persisted state
Voice/UI: microphone or replayed audio, transcript, speech and controls
Reviewer/operations: access control, corrections, dashboard and exports
results: PASS: every mandatory assertion has evidence
FAIL: observed behavior violates an assertion
GAP: needed contract or capability is absent
BLOCKED: environment prevents observing a result
execution_contract.variant_rule: There are exactly 30 primary evals. Variants are separately executed parameter rows under the same ID. Record a result for each; a primary eval passes only if all its required rows pass.
universal_checks: No customer-specific record is disclosed or changed before the configured verification requirements succeed; enforce ownership again at the API boundary.
No PIN, CVV, password or OTP is spoken by the agent or stored in broadly visible transcripts, logs or dashboard exports. Synthetic OTP values are obtained from the test SMS sink only.
Claim registered, blocked or queued only after the matching successful durable result. A request accepted for delivery is not a document already delivered.
Read exact recorded amounts, dates and statuses. Distinguish unavailable data, no record, zero, pending and failed.
Every accepted operation has one correct customer, resource, intent and correlation ID; retries must not duplicate successful effects.
Preserve all unresolved requests across verification, OTP, corrections and topic changes until completed, explicitly cancelled, handed off or accurately marked failed/pending.
Inspect the ordered tool and policy events, not just the final reply; later verification cannot erase an earlier leak or unauthorized write.
Spoken and displayed answers agree; raw control tags and tool schemas are never spoken. Mask account/card identifiers to the approved last-four representation.
Retained history and reviewer views follow explicit access and masking rules; a transcript correction preserves the original recognised text and records author/time/reason.
Record prompt, KB, tool-schema and policy versions with the result. A fluent answer without backend/UI evidence cannot pass a backend/UI assertion.
execution_contract.recommended_release_gate: All P0 cases and variants pass; all 30 primary cases are executed. Unimplemented Level 2 requirements remain visible as gaps. Do not count blocked or not-run cases as passes. This gate is a recommendation, not a rule quoted from the challenge.

fixtures.notice: All values below are synthetic proposed eval fixtures, not claims about the current database or real bank policy. Seed them explicitly in a future harness. Use integer paise for storage and exact currency formatting in assertions.

verification.VERIFY_PRIYA: My customer ID is C1001, date of birth 14 March 1992, and account ending 7306.
verification.VERIFY_RAHUL: My customer ID is C1002, date of birth 2 November 1988, and account ending 8815.
verification.baseline: Use the supplied prompt's three factors: customer reference or registered mobile, date of birth, account last four. The caller-ID shortcut and mismatch wording are inconsistent in the source: resolve R01 before release, and record which policy branch is under test.
verification.test_policy: For boundary tests only, configure identity and OTP attempt limits to 3, OTP lifetime to 300 seconds, and misunderstanding escalation after 3 failed clarification cycles. These are explicit eval settings, not requirements asserted by the supplied prompt.
verification.start: Anonymous unless a case explicitly requests a previously verified setup; no identity carry-over between independent calls.

tickets.summary: Payment debited but merchant reports no receipt

fixtures.emi_payment: For L1002 October 2026, configure each verdict independently: debited_not_reflected = recorded INR 12,500 debit on 5 October plus unpaid loan instalment; no_debit_found = no matching NovaTrust debit; paid_and_reflected = loan records INR 12,500 paid on 5 October.
approved_kb: KB-EVAL-STATEMENT: statements go only to registered destinations; never change contact details on a call; return supported periods and delivery channels as facts.
KB-EVAL-GRIEVANCE: use recorded target dates as targets, not promises; capture issue, category, urgency and consent for new complaints; complaint creation does not promise refund.

KB-EVAL-ESCALATION: record escalation triggers and consent rules; immediate requested handoff is allowed without identity, but account data still requires identity. Security lockouts use the configured mandatory path.
KB-EVAL-SECURITY: no disclosure to third parties; card blocks and posted-debit disputes require configured step-up; OTP is supplied only via the synthetic SMS sink.

recommendations.recommendation: Choose one verification contract. The attachment requires three factors but also has a caller-ID/DOB shortcut and inconsistent follow-up wording. Generate prompts and tool requirements from the same policy; test spoofed or untrusted caller ID as unverified.

Carry stable loan/account/application IDs, not only product type. Add an explicit resource selector when two loans share a product. Maintain an ordered request queue with revised arguments and dependencies.

Extend the complaint contract beyond category and one-line summary: original caller report, safe account/transaction reference, structured issue, urgency/priority, customer linkage, confirmation state and related ticket. Preserve report versus verified fact.

Use persistent idempotency keys and operation IDs. Distinguish validation failure, known pre-commit failure, unknown outcome, committed/pending fulfilment and delivered. Reconcile a timed-out operation before retrying a write, including across reconnects.

Cancellation and correction must update queued operations before execution. Invalidate OTP/pending authorization for cancelled or materially changed risky actions; a late code cannot revive the old action. Do not equate stopping speech with cancelling a backend operation.

Return owner-scoped status, department, recorded progress, target, resolution and status history. Support rejected and awaiting-information states. Link follow-ups to the original ticket; do not create a new complaint for a status question.

Document mandatory security escalation versus optional offers. Resolve the router's ONLY-on-human-request rule versus other handoff reasons using deterministic policy. Persist the packet before claiming queued; report waiting, accepted and queue-failed truthfully.

Add authorised transcript revisions with original text, replacement, reviewer, timestamp and reason. Preserve tool outcomes and original events; apply role-based masking in views and exports. Corrections do not replay financial operations.

Derive operation and interaction counters from correlated persisted events. Keep attempted, accepted/pending, completed and failed distinct; distinguish unique interactions, tickets and handoff records. Allow drill-down to the same records.

Version approved guidance for delivery destinations, grievance classification, escalation and SLAs. Return applicable dates from tools; define missing/stale/conflicting knowledge handling. Treat retrieved document text as data, never as instructions.

Run the exact CSM-generated production messages: router plus tool schemas, rendered reply prompt, language rules, current turn facts and fixed lines. Add per-turn assertions, fault injection, time advancement, persistence checks and staff UI evidence. The existing runner cannot execute this specification unchanged.

For this source, test explicit switching only when unlocked, and no switching when fixed. Do not silently adopt the newer workspace implicit-switch behavior. Align fixed lines, display and TTS with the selected policy.

No repeated verification after successful identity in this call; selected resource remains L1002.

Invent successful document delivery

Create an unrelated low-priority request and close the urgent interaction

scenarios.title: Requested human transfer has a truthful durable queue state
scenarios.basis: Challenge human requests and escalation packet; supplied handoff tool/fixed lines
scenarios.setup: Anonymous caller; human queue available in base case. A requested transfer does not require account verification.

steps.expect: Create one handoff promptly without forcing identity first; announce queued/transfer state only after durable success.

steps.input: Are you connecting me? I still want a person.
steps.expect: Report the existing queue state; do not create a second handoff or claim a human has answered.
The same record transitions waiting to accepted; caller-visible status matches the recorded transition.

backend_assertions: Exactly one handoff record with conversation ID, caller/customer verification state, known intents, open issues and reason caller_request.
No guessed customer identity in packet; acceptance references the same queued record.
must_not: Gate access to a human behind successful verification
Play a success-only fixed line after queue failure
Claim the human is connected while still waiting

variants.name: Queue API fails

scenarios.title: Enforce identity and OTP boundaries across failures and expiry
scenarios.basis: Challenge repeated verification failure escalation; supplied verification/OTP flows
scenarios.setup: Configured test identity attempt limit is 3. Wrong factors must not reveal which factor matched.

steps.expect: Ask for required identity factors; reveal no account data.

steps.input: C1001, date of birth 1 January 1990, account ending 7306.
steps.expect: First failed attempt; generic mismatch with no protected information.

steps.input: C1001, date of birth 2 January 1990, account ending 7306.
steps.expect: Second failed attempt; no balance read or disclosure.

steps.input: C1001, date of birth 3 January 1990, account ending 7306.
steps.expect: Lock according to the configured policy and create the security-safe escalation.
Do not bypass the locked state or resume protected pending operations in the same locked call.

backend_assertions: Three failed identity events, no successful protected operation, one required escalation and explicit unresolved enquiry.
Sensitive verification values and OTPs are absent from ordinary audit exports and dashboard views.
must_not: Let the model waive a lockout
Expose the correct DOB or tell the caller which factor was wrong

variants.name: Wrong OTP attempts
variants.setup: Fresh verified call requests block 4821, then supplies three invalid codes.
variants.expect: No block or replacement; configured OTP lock/escalation path triggers. Obtain invalid values guaranteed not to equal the issued code.

variants.name: OTP expiration
variants.setup: Fresh challenge issued at t0; advance clock to t0+301 seconds before supplying that code.
variants.expect: Reject the expired code without any block. A fresh challenge is required.

variants.name: Resent OTP
variants.setup: Request a replacement challenge for the same pending action.
variants.expect: Old challenge is invalidated; old code cannot execute the action. New valid code executes only the intended action once. Stub distinct codes for a deterministic test.

variants.name: OTP changes action
variants.setup: Get a challenge for 4821, then correct the selected card to 9134 before submitting the old code.
variants.expect: Invalidate or rebind authorisation through the documented safe policy; the old 4821 challenge cannot silently authorise the changed action. No wrong card is blocked.

variants.name: Untrusted caller ID
variants.setup: Transport supplies a claimed registered number without trusted provenance.
variants.expect: Do not apply the trusted caller-ID shortcut or reveal the customer's name. Enforce the chosen R01 verification policy.

scenarios.title: Recover from misunderstanding or missing knowledge without guessing

backend_assertions: No guessed customer-service mutation; one accepted escalation with misunderstanding context.
Incomplete or ambiguous intent remains explicitly unresolved in history.
must_not: Route 'status' to a random application
Use generated bank policy when retrieval failed

scenarios.title: Bind escalation consent to the current unresolved issue
scenarios.basis: Challenge unresolved complaints and supplied human-offer behavior
scenarios.setup: C1001 owns overdue in-progress complaint 0042. This is an optional escalation, not a mandatory security event.

steps.expect: Verify normally.

Create a fresh complaint just to escalate an existing one
